ARC1818I.pattern: ^AUTO DUMP TERMINATED EARLY,\s*(?<not_processed>\d+) VOLUMES FROM COPY POOL (?<copy_pool>\S+) WERE NOT PROCESSED

ARC1814I.pattern: ^FAST REPLICATION BACKUP HAS COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY AND DUMP IS NOW STARTING FOR COPY POOL (?<copy_pool>[^,\s]+),\s*VERSION (?<version>\d+)
